name: capacity-guard
description: Remaining-quota threshold and reset guard for long-running Codex tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Stop long tasks at a chosen remaining-quota threshold.
interface.longDescription: Capacity Guard confirms the current quota and a whole-percentage stop threshold before activation, then safely stops hook-visible new work on threshold, reset, or observation boundaries.
defaultPrompt: Use $capacity-guard to run this task until the remaining quota reaches my chosen threshold.
